summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a routine Form 6-K, the foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report or interim report, covering the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing consists primarily of XBRL-tagged financial data, related-party warrant disclosures, a registration rights agreement, and subsequent-event notes dated through late September 2026. No special-situation transaction is disclosed: there is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private proposal, strategic review, activist stake, spin-off, or capital return. Terms such as price per share, premium, and close date are absent, so no deal terms apply.
